name: @tabnas/measure
description: Reproducible capability and performance measurements for Tabnas ports.

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:go && npm run build:rs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/docs.test.mjs scripts/toolchain.test.mjs scripts/provenance.test.mjs scripts/deterministic.test.mjs && npm run test:ports && node scripts/run-all.mjs --profile smoke --output .build/smoke-run && node scripts/validate-repository.mjs --run .build/smoke-run && npm run site && node scripts/smoke-site.mjs
scripts.test:ports: GOWORK=off go test ./... && cargo test --locked --manifest-path ports/rust/Cargo.toml --target-dir .build/rust
